author: MGG7
quote: I really wanted to like GTA 6, but the more I played, the more I hated it. The writing and protagonists just ****. Jason has the personality of wet toast. He's a complete doormat, bending over backwards for Lucia while she takes advantage of him and disrespects him. He has no backbone, barely any personality, and doesn't have any opinions of his own. Lucia is even worse. She is insufferable, unlikeable, manipulative, etc. Literally zero redeemable qualities. She's clearly meant to be the main character, with Jason written as an afterthought. Yeah, other GTA protagonists were terrible people, but they were funny and likeable. THE "HUMOR" IN THIS GAME IS PAINFULLY BAD. You can tell the devs were trying so hard to be funny like the other games. I wish they didn't attempt any humor at all. That would be infinitely better than the mental torture they wrote into the game. GTA was an offensive, ridiculous, and edgy title, thats what made it so funny and great. GTA 6 has none of that. This shouldn't be shocking to anyone. Today's Rockstar is completely different from the Rockstar we knew and loved. Dan Houser left, along with 80% of the old team. This really **** because the sandbox is really fun and the world looks cool. If you ignore the story and never pick Lucia up, maybe it could be a good game, but then you are locked out of the main mechanics, so that's not an option. There are also an unacceptable number of bugs in the game. This isn't a GTA. GTA died when Dan and the old dev team left. Really goes to show why you should never pre-order a game no matter what title.
